source_instruction: i am looking for a low carbohydrates protein bar with package of 12 counts.
query: Oh man, that golden retriever I passed by the community park entrance on my walk over was so silly, it was fully flopped on its back in the middle of the sidewalk wiggling so hard its whole body shook, just begging every person who walked by for quick belly rubs. The barista at the little corner spot right by the store doors remembered my usual order today too, they added an extra dash of cinnamon to my iced oat milk latte without me even asking, and it tasted cozier than any version I’ve gotten there before. I even spotted a cluster of tiny bright orange wild mushrooms popping up through the mulch around the oak tree right by the cart return, they looked like little fairy-sized party umbrellas tucked between the fallen acorns. I’ve heard the breakfast foods section has a bunch of solid picks for anyone browsing that part of the store, I’ve heard the low-sugar ones there are a really solid option, I’ve heard there’s that one pack size I always get that’s stocked there right now, and I’ve heard it works out well when the total doesn’t go over $40.
